disclaimer.note: The mission simulation uses predefined phase durations and deterministic gameplay rules. It is not an orbital-mechanics or engineering-accurate model.

descriptions.phaseDurations: Launch 1 day, orbital arrival 2 days, landing 3 days. Transit uses the selected orbit; construction ends when progress reaches 100%; operations run until the mission duration ends.
descriptions.lunarDay: Surface time alternates ~14.75 days of daylight and night. Robots and instruments work only in daylight; at night the lander enters survival mode.
descriptions.propellant: Transfer propellant is spent 20% in transit, 35% at orbital arrival, 45% during landing.
descriptions.operationsCost: Mission operations cost $0.1M per day from the remaining budget.
descriptions.events: Events trigger from deterministic design conditions (component reliability, thermal capacity, battery charge), never from random rolls.
